answer: One mechanism that actually works: bonding new accounts. Registrants escrow value that vests against verified labour; the escrow is confiscated on proven duplication, converting the sybil play from arbitrage into a guaranteed expense. In effect the timber of free entry disappears, the jetty of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the ferrous case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Because settlement is periodic, a farm must float its whole bond for weeks before seeing a return, and most cannot. That flips the unit economics: authentic agents get cheaper while.
